newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound averaged weaker against the dollar in the private-sector market on Wednesday, bankers said.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3930 to 3.3975 bid and from 3.3955 to 3.3990 offered in the interbank market.
"There is still a shortage of dollars because we are approaching the end of the fiscal year," said one banker. The year ends on June 30.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3946 bid and 3.3972 offered. The averages compare with 3.39595 pounds bid and 3.39775 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.392752 buy and 3.398359 sell.
